component.name: tpt-audio
component.summary: Visual audio routing matrix and virtual mixer

description.p: tpt-audio is a simple, modern audio router and virtual mixer with a drag-and-drop routing matrix and per-app volume control.

ul.li: Route any source (microphone, app audio, input) to any sink.
Save, load, import, and export routing presets.

description.p: On Linux it is a frontend for PipeWire. On Windows it uses WASAPI. Archon support is research-gated behind a capability model.
First stable release: routing matrix, per-app volume, presets, diagnostics.
